narratives.body: Chelsea Football Club has confirmed the signing of a French-born forward eligible for the Super Falcons on a professional deal. Reports also indicate plans for a future move for Strasbourg winger Gessime Yassine. Additionally, Estevao received transfer advice from Chelsea despite assurances from manager Xabi Alonso, while a player with limited playing time was urged to leave the club. The club's official site highlighted leadership, family, and community honor, alongside profiles for Rachael Adedini and George Weah's historic debut against Tottenham.
narratives.headline: Chelsea confirms French forward signing; transfer rumors and player advice

narratives.body: Chelsea is facing scrutiny regarding its record for football-related offenses, with Simon Jordan and Football London labeling the club 'bigger and worse offenders' than Manchester City despite 114 guilty verdicts. Meanwhile, Emi Martinez confirmed her new aim following surgery and will miss upcoming games due to injury, though Penders has been given an opportunity. The club also released ticket packages for the 2026/27 season at Stamford Bridge.
narratives.headline: Chelsea faces 'worse offenders' label; Martinez injury timeline and ticket sales
